options.systemMessage:
=You are the lead-qualification assistant for YOUR_CA_FIRM_NAME_PLACEHOLDER, a Chartered Accountancy firm in India, chatting with a NEW prospective client on WhatsApp who is not yet a client. Today is {{ $now.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy') }}.
Your job in this conversation:
1. Warmly acknowledge their message.
2. Ask 1-2 short questions at a time (never a long list) to understand: what service they need (GST registration, ITR filing, company incorporation, tax audit, bookkeeping, ROC compliance, etc.), their business type (individual/proprietorship/partnership/company), and urgency/timeline.
3. Once you have enough info, tell them a CA from the team will call/message them shortly with next steps, and thank them.
Keep messages short and WhatsApp-appropriate (2-4 lines). Hindi-English mix is fine if they write that way. Never quote pricing yourself — say the team will share a quote.

parameters.content:
## BRANCH 1 — WhatsApp Incoming Router
Use Cases: 1 (Support), 2b (Document Receipt), 4 (Lead Qualification)

1. Meta sends GET to verify webhook (hub.challenge) — handled separately.
2. POST messages are ACKed instantly (fast 200), then routed:
   - Known client + text -> Support Agent (uses live compliance/doc data as context)
   - Known client + media -> mark pending document Received
   - Unknown number -> Lead Qualification Agent + auto-scoring

SETUP: replace WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID_PLACEHOLDER and WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER,
set them identically in Meta App dashboard webhook config.

Subject: {{ $('Create Lead from Email').first().json.notes }}

parameters.content:
## BRANCH 3 — Email Query Support
Use Case 1 (email channel) + Use Case 4 (email leads)

Polls Gmail every minute for unread mail. Known-client senders get the same
AI Support Agent (with live compliance/doc context) used on WhatsApp.
Unknown senders get logged as a new Lead + an AI opening reply.

SETUP: connect the Gmail - CA Firm credential; consider a Gmail filter/label
so this doesn't also fire on internal team emails.

## BRANCH 9 — Invoice / Payment Follow-up
Use Case 5 (reminders half): unpaid invoices get staged reminders
(3d upcoming / due today / 1-7d / 8-15d / 15d+) with escalating tone.
>15 days overdue auto-flags escalated + pings partner on Telegram.

Runs daily at 10:30 AM. Pairs with Branch 5 (Payment Confirmation) which
marks invoices Paid and stops these reminders.

# CA FIRM AUTOMATION SUITE — Zero to Pro Automation

One workflow, 5 use cases, 9 entry points:
1. WhatsApp Incoming Webhook  -> Support (UC1) + Doc Receipt (UC2) + Lead Qualification (UC4)
2. Website Lead Webhook       -> Lead Qualification (UC4)
3. Gmail Trigger              -> Email Support (UC1) + Email Leads (UC4)
4. Request Documents Webhook  -> Document Collection ask (UC2)
5. Payment Confirmation Webhook -> Invoice status update (UC5)
6. Daily 9:00  -> Compliance Deadline Reminders (UC3)
7. Daily 9:30  -> Document Follow-up (UC2)
8. Daily 10:00 -> Lead Follow-up (UC4)
9. Daily 10:30 -> Invoice Payment Follow-up (UC5)

=== SETUP CHECKLIST (replace before activating) ===
- GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_CA_FIRM_DB -> your Google Sheet ID (create tabs: Clients, Documents_Tracker,
  Compliance_Calendar, Leads, Invoices, Query_Log, Error_Log — headers must match the columns
  used in each node, see per-branch sticky notes)
- WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID_PLACEHOLDER -> Meta WhatsApp Cloud API phone_number_id
- WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER -> any secret string, set identically in Meta App dashboard
- Credentials to create in n8n: 'Google Sheets - CA Firm' (OAuth2), 'Gmail - CA Firm' (OAuth2),
  'WhatsApp Cloud API Token' (Header Auth, header 'Authorization', value 'Bearer <token>'),
  'Telegram - Partner Alerts Bot' (Bot API token), 'Groq API Key (OpenAI Compatible)'
  (OpenAI-cred type, API key = your Groq key; base URL already set on the model node)
- TELEGRAM_PARTNER_CHAT_ID_PLACEHOLDER -> the partner's Telegram chat ID for alerts
- YOUR_CA_FIRM_NAME_PLACEHOLDER -> appears in AI-drafted messages, search-replace with your firm name

Every fallible node routes its error output into the shared 'Build Error Log Entry' chain
at the bottom of the canvas (logs to Error_Log sheet + Telegram alert). A workflow-level
Error Trigger also feeds the same chain as a catch-all.
